newsitem.title: USA: Mako Marine to sell controlling stake.
newsitem.headline: Mako Marine to sell controlling stake.

text.p: Mako Marine International Inc said on Friday that it has entered a letter of intent to sell a controlling interest in the company to Tracker Marine LP, a Springfield, Missouri boat manufacturer.

Under the deal, Mako will sell a controlling block of its equity to Tracker Marine in exchange for an infusion of cash and the contribution of certain assets related to Tracker Marine's saltwater fishing boat manufacturing business, the company said.

Mako Marine said the deal also contemplates a marketing alignment that will feature Mako Marine products in fishing magazines such as "Bass Pro Shops," "Off-Shore Angler" and "World-Wide Sportsman" catalogs.
No other terms of the proposed deal were disclosed.
The proposed transaction is subject to certain conditions including a due diligence review by both parties and the execution and delivery of a definitive agreement, Mako Marine said.
Mako will remain a publicly held company and retain the name Mako Marine International Inc, the company said.
